review_evidence: README identifies NodeGraph as a toolset for viewing and automatically creating dependency graphs in the Lean 4 infoview.

Complete scan of the 22 primary Lean files shows command elaborators, widgets, dependency collection, graph serialization/reduction utilities and weighted-sorry tooling. The only theorem/axiom-bearing file is Test.lean, which is explicitly the README demonstration and contains a toy axiom plus a theorem proved by sorry.
The Lake file configures the package; no independent mathematical development is present outside the tooling demonstration.

source_action.content_invariant: All substantive source implements graph/widget/elaboration tooling; the only proposition-bearing test is the README toy example using an axiom and sorry, so retirement removes no independent mathematical theorem/proof corpus.
